descriptions.text: Soul Crystal. F-Quality. Used to power the balloon that keeps this house afloat. Nothing too exciting. You probably want to avoid breaking it, though. Charge: 89% Kill something to charge it up.

recap.text: Carl tells Bonnie the house has to leave, and she pulls a walnut-like necklace from her shirt, fiddles with it, and the house settles. Inside its sliding clamshell is a purple-hued soul crystal, which stopped feeding the balloon under the goose's anti-magic aura. Katia says they could never have flown the house without the controller Carl left with Louis.

beats.headline: A walnut on a string
beats.text: The suburban house has come down cockeyed on a dune half a mile east of Hump Town, and since Denise died its magical balloon has been slowly refilling. The ropes are like steel cables. Carl tells Bonnie they have to leave; she pulls a walnut-like necklace from her shirt, fiddles with it, and the house settles. Her dad gave it to her with the potion, she says, and told her to give it to an adult. Inside a sliding clamshell is a little purple-hued gem, a soul crystal. It stopped feeding the balloon under the goose's anti-magic aura. Carl keeps it, the shell open just a fraction: enough, he hopes, to keep the balloon off the ground but not to lift the house.
beats.gist: Bonnie's walnut necklace holds a soul crystal, and Carl keeps its shell open a crack.

beats.headline: The controller left with Louis
beats.text: In the personal space, Katia catches Carl up. Once she learned they would not know his fate for a few days, she took matters into her own hands and tried flying the house to the land quadrant. It would not let them at first, until they worked out what was wrong. If Carl had not left the controller with Louis, she says, they never could have flown the thing. Louis and Firas have turned into quite the pilots, and they are already on the way back to pick him up.
beats.gist: Katia says the house would not fly until fixed; Carl's controller, left with Louis, made it possible.
